topic: AI Tool Sprawl Control Map: 6 Safe Questions Before Adding Another App
boundary: Educational operations guide only — not legal, compliance, financial, security, procurement, certification, revenue, savings, approval, or guaranteed-performance advice.

checks.owner_question: What work is actually slow, risky or duplicated today?
checks.safe_action: Write the problem in plain language before comparing AI features.

checks.owner_question: Which apps already collect, store, summarize or send the same information?
checks.safe_action: List owners, logins, costs and data touched by each tool.

checks.owner_question: Where does work move from customer, staff, vendor, inbox, spreadsheet or dashboard?
checks.safe_action: Fix the handoff rule before adding another automation layer.

checks.owner_question: Which outputs may affect customers, payments, staff, private data or public claims?
checks.safe_action: Keep human review for sensitive or externally visible outputs.

checks.owner_question: Which files, inboxes, chats or records should stay out of the pilot?
checks.safe_action: Start with the smallest safe data set and document exclusions.

checks.owner_question: What evidence will show whether this tool should expand, pause or be removed?
checks.safe_action: Use internal observations and owner feedback; avoid inflated ROI claims.

safe_scope: Educational tool-sprawl control checklist; no legal, compliance, financial, security, procurement, certification, revenue, savings, approval or performance guarantees.
